entities.name: Procopius of Ustyug
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Procopius of Ustyug or Procopius of Lübeck was a fool for Christ (yurodivy) and miracle worker, formerly a merchant from Lübeck. He was canonized as a saint by the Russian Orthodox Church.
